recommendation.direction: Stylized action-game menus with a deliberate graphic identity, strong item-art hierarchy and clear interactive states
recommendation.layout: Inventory grid plus a large selected-ball panel and one prominent Equip action. Store uses four existing preview offers and a featured collection area.
recommendation.artwork: Create original header accents, shaped frames and button artwork as coordinated assets; keep labels, artwork slots, selection and controls separate and editable.
recommendation.typography: Heavy italic sans for display headings; simpler upright sans for descriptions and small labels. Exact font not selected and no font identification claim.
recommendation.color: Do not inherit the discarded palette as a constraint. Establish a new coherent accent system while keeping content and interactions readable.
recommendation.practical: Phone reflow, consistent selected/equipped labels, readable copy and normal obvious Close target; only existing functions represented.
